verdict.rationale: There is no dedicated bulk-export feature. Instead, data can be pulled out programmatically through the REST API (events, function runs, environments) and the CLI (runs, traces), and the self-hostable server gives you a way to move off the hosted platform. Functions are plain TypeScript/Python/Go code deployed on your own infrastructure, which also lowers lock-in. Missing for 10: a documented one-shot full-account export, explicit open export formats (e.g. JSON/CSV dumps or OTel trace export), a migration guide from hosted to self-hosted, and independent hands-on reports of leaving successfully.
